body:
There are two ways to edit `JSON` in the Godot editor:
1. In the internal text editor, modify the `JSON` by editing the `text`, then parse the `text` using `JSON::parse()` to update the `data`.
2. In the inspector, modify the `JSON` by calling `JSON::set_data()` to set the `data`, which will clear the `text`.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4ebf67c12dcdffcb69242569c118a371a654b6ae/core/io/json.cpp#L542-L545

These two approaches are somewhat conflicting.
   
>  * the console doesn't say nothing (it should say "Json Changed!")

In this case, when the JSON‘s `data` (and perhaps `text`) changes it should emit a `changed` signal, but it doesn't.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4ebf67c12dcdffcb69242569c118a371a654b6ae/core/io/json.cpp#L578-L587


> * NOW the console says "Json Changed!"

External modification will trigger a `reload_from_file()` call. `JSON` does not override `reload_from_file()` and `copy_from()`.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4ebf67c12dcdffcb69242569c118a371a654b6ae/editor/editor_node.cpp#L1174-L1176

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4ebf67c12dcdffcb69242569c118a371a654b6ae/core/io/resource.cpp#L266

This `changed` signal is actually triggered when `name` is copied in `copy_from()`.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4ebf67c12dcdffcb69242569c118a371a654b6ae/core/io/resource.cpp#L180-L183


>  * the embedded editor opens up blank, with "Unknown Error Getting Token"

This is because `Resource::copy_from()` only copies properties that have `PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE` enabled. In `JSON`, only the `data` property is registered, not the `text`. When copying `data`, `text` is cleared instead.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4ebf67c12dcdffcb69242569c118a371a654b6ae/core/io/json.cpp#L622
